summary: Allegiant Travel Company filed an 8-K reporting on a pending acquisition of Sun Country Airlines Holdings, Inc. via a two-step merger structure. The deal, announced January 11, 2026, involves Merger Sub 1 merging into Sun Country, followed by Sun Country merging into Merger Sub 2. Allegiant filed a Form S-4 (effective March 31, 2026) and a joint proxy statement/prospectus. Stockholder meetings for both companies are scheduled for May 8, 2026. Two lawsuits filed in New York Supreme Court (Weiss and Williams) and demand letters challenge the deal. The specific terms (price per share, premium, break fee) are not disclosed in this excerpt. Watch for litigation outcomes or potential disclosure adjustments ahead of the vote.
